intent: Resume the existing memory-semiconductors storage-productization lane for enterprise SSD / QLC / AI-storage demand. Reuse the current source-preservation, Grounded Evidence, canonical Reality/comparability, Judgment-Outcome, no-lookahead replay/research-only and historical verification-depth owners. Preserve product-capacity specifications as technical evidence without inferring shipments, installed base, exabytes, adoption or market demand; promote only claim-scoped source-grounded observations that satisfy the existing owner contracts.
rationale_summary: No new semantic owner is required. CAP-0001 owns truthful source identity/preservation; CAP-0002 owns exact claim-scoped Evidence; CAP-0003 owns Reality normalization/comparability and rejects guidance or inferred occurrence as Reality; CAP-0004 owns contemporaneous expectation/revision and later Outcome; CAP-0005 owns no-lookahead/research-only researcher visibility; CAP-0006 owns Memory-first verification and unresolved-search depth. The storage batch is a productization composition across those owners, with a hard negative case that high-capacity QLC product specifications do not establish market adoption or demand quantities.
